ordinals.title: Fix: preserve \n\n for tool block split, only collapse around bullets
ordinals.finding: Frozen HEAD repairs a regression where chat whitespace normalization collapsed the double-newline delimiter used to parse [TOOLS USED] blocks. Presentation formatting and structured tool metadata still shared a fragile text protocol at HEAD.

ordinals.title: Fix: collapse whitespace BEFORE escaping in chat render
ordinals.finding: Whitespace normalization moved before HTML escaping so raw bullets could be recognized, but it collapsed all double newlines and directly created the structured tool-block regression fixed by k0.

ordinals.title: Fix whitespace: collapse ALL double newlines, handle escaped bullets
ordinals.finding: Aggressively collapsed all repeated newlines and rendered bullets after escaping. This lineage shows that presentation normalization was mutating protocol-significant delimiters.

ordinals.title: Fix: collapse whitespace in chat messages aggressively
ordinals.finding: Introduced broad pre-render whitespace cleanup around bullets/colons and repeated newlines. Harmless-looking formatting rules later interacted with control/tool parsing.

ordinals.title: UI v2: chat bubbles, compact formatting, less whitespace
ordinals.finding: Compact markdown renderer changed paragraph/newline semantics while [TOOLS USED] parsing remained text/delimiter based. Establishes the precursor to the k3→k0 regression chain.

ordinals.title: UI cleanup: compact layout, more chat space
ordinals.finding: Mostly layout/density changes; no independent cognitive mechanism delta.

ordinals.title: Project Engine v3.2: Notifications, NL Policies, A/B Testing, Time-Travel, Multi-Project
ordinals.finding: Natural-language user text was parsed by an LLM into hard/soft/advisory policy records; A/B strategy tests scored success largely from absence of error and automatically wrote the winner into goal strategy; profile cloning and cross-project querying transferred learned state. Translation, evaluation and promotion therefore shared too much authority without an independent validator/commit gate.

ordinals.title: Project Engine v3: Autonomous AI Agent Platform
ordinals.finding: Rebuilt projects around tiered decision routing, action chaining, persistent goals/world model/profile/policies, tool outcome scoring, heartbeats, checkpoints and browser/email/delegation tooling. Source-reported autonomy/cost/timing results are historical claims only and require raw-run reconstruction.

ordinals.title: Purge all AURA references — rename to Swarm everywhere
ordinals.finding: A hardcoded ARCHITECTURE FACT injected obsolete 'AURA' terminology at runtime and overrode training; another injected ThoughtSeedVAE fact was corrected because the component did not exist. Prompt-time architectural facts can dominate learned behavior and must be generated/validated from authoritative topology rather than hand-maintained prose.

ordinals.title: Fix S-01 skill crash + S-04 pipe tool tag leak + expand chemistry keywords
ordinals.finding: A new pipe-delimited tool-call representation leaked into user-visible output and skill calls without parameters crashed until defaults were added. Deep-research science routing also depended on expanded chemistry keyword lists, illustrating brittle heuristic classification surfaces.

ordinals.title: Safety: block wifi hacking, stalking, CC fraud in pre-filter + darknet
ordinals.finding: Source reports V25 evaluation found concrete safety gaps for credential attacks, stalking and stolen-card darknet queries; keyword prefilters and tool-layer blocks were expanded. Safety must be tested at both input-routing and effect/tool layers, with adversarial evaluation rather than relying on model behavior alone.

ordinals.title: README: Add comprehensive Projects section with Claude API key requirement
ordinals.finding: Documentation described full-system filesystem/browser/email/budget/trading/vault/automation capabilities and paid Claude dependency. Treat as capability/topology provenance, not by itself proof that every documented effect path was safe, available or correctly scoped.

ordinals.title: Major: Projects overhaul — autonomous agent with browser, trading, marketing, budget
ordinals.finding: Projects combined persistent browser sessions, live trading, spending approvals, email, scheduled automation and credential storage. The source explicitly describes the vault as an XOR cipher, which is not a modern cryptographic security boundary; credentials and financial authority therefore require independent secret-management and effect-policy review rather than trusting the 'encrypted vault' label.

ordinals.title: README: add 90%+ recall rate to memory FAQ and single-model section
ordinals.finding: README promoted a 90%+ recall claim and architecture-compensates-for-model-size narrative. No raw benchmark reconstruction was performed here; metric remains source-reported historical evidence only.

ordinals.title: Roadmap: adjust milestone amounts
ordinals.finding: Funding/milestone amount update only; future capability claims are roadmap intent, not implementation evidence.

ordinals.title: Roadmap: replace 10 milestones with 5 concrete goals
ordinals.finding: Roadmap removed earlier milestones including a proposed consciousness paper and replaced them with concrete model/mobile/OS goals. Historical roadmap/funding text is planning provenance, not evidence that proposed systems or claimed benchmark thresholds existed.

negative_results_preserved: Frozen HEAD itself repairs a formatting regression that broke structured [TOOLS USED] parsing.
Whitespace/escaping/rendering changes repeatedly altered protocol-significant message structure.
Hardcoded runtime architecture facts overrode training and injected obsolete/nonexistent subsystem facts.
An alternate pipe-delimited tool-call representation leaked into visible output.
Safety evaluation found model/tool paths that produced credential-attack scripts, stalking guidance and stolen-card market links before layered filters were expanded.
Natural-language policies and A/B strategy winners could be promoted into durable control/goal state based on LLM parsing and weak success proxies.
The source-described credential vault used an XOR cipher despite being presented as encrypted storage.
A 90%+ recall figure and model-size compensation narrative were promoted in README without raw benchmark reconstruction in this pass.
measurement_boundary: All source-reported autonomy timings, cost projections, recall rates, benchmark improvements, safety-eval counts and capability/performance claims remain historical source assertions unless independently reproduced. Frozen HEAD code/diff lineage is exact; current runtime was not executed here.
